website-cost-south-africa.answer: A small-business website from Kubhexa Digital starts at R2,990 for a one-page site. Business websites start at R5,990, Showcase at R8,990, Bookings at R11,990 and Shop at R17,990. Your total depends on scope, hosting, domain registration and any external subscriptions. Request an estimate for your project.
faqs: What is the cheapest Kubhexa package?
Start begins at R2,990 for a one-page website.
Are hosting and domains included?
These can cost extra; confirm them in your quote.
Is VAT included?
VAT is added only if applicable; confirm the final quote.
What determines the final price?
Scope, selected extras and any external services affect the final amount.
Can I compare designs first?
Yes, explore the six interactive templates before requesting an estimate.

what-included-r2990-website.answer: Kubhexa Digital’s Start package begins at R2,990 for a customised one-page website. It is designed as a starting point for small businesses that need a clear online presence. Explore the Neighbour template, prepare your business information and request a quotation to confirm inclusions, scope and additional costs.
faqs: Is R2,990 the final price?
It is the starting price; final scope and extras are confirmed in the quote.
Who is Start for?
It is intended for sole traders, freelancers and home businesses needing a one-page site.
Can I see a sample?
Yes, Neighbour is an interactive fictional-business template.
Can I add extra pages?
Additional pages may change scope; request an estimate for a multi-page option.

choose-website-package.answer: Choose a website package based on what customers need to do. Start suits a simple online presence, Business suits service businesses needing multiple pages, Showcase suits portfolios and menus, Bookings suits appointment-led businesses, and Shop suits online retailers. Compare starting prices, requirements and templates before requesting a quote.
faqs: What package suits a sole trader?
Start may suit a simple one-page presence.
What package suits a salon?
Bookings is designed for appointment-led businesses and starts at R11,990.
Which package supports an online shop?
Shop starts at R17,990 for small-business e-commerce.
Can I compare interactive layouts?
Yes, use the six template presentation pages.
Can scope change?
Yes; confirm final inclusions and extra costs before approval.

small-business-website-checklist.answer: A small-business website needs clear service information, your business identity, a useful contact method, mobile-friendly pages, accessible navigation, trustworthy content, accurate pricing or quotation guidance, search-friendly metadata, secure HTTPS and a plan for updates. Start with the features that help customers understand your offer and take the next step.
faqs: Do I need a large website?
Not necessarily; a one-page site may suit a simple offer.
What should customers see first?
A clear description of what you do and the next action.
Should I list prices?
Use accurate prices or explain how quotes are calculated.
Do I need a mobile website?
A responsive website should work on phones, tablets and desktops.

website-generates-enquiries.answer: A website can support customer enquiries when visitors immediately understand your offer, see relevant examples and have a clear way to contact you. Keep pages responsive, use concise service descriptions, work examples and a simple enquiry form. Measure completed enquiries rather than clicks alone, and improve the journey using real data.
faqs: Will a website guarantee enquiries?
No; results depend on demand, visibility, offer and usability.
Is a contact form enough?
A clear enquiry journey is important; a verified email or WhatsApp may help if offered.
How do I measure enquiries?
Track a successful submission and reconcile it with the enquiry register.
Should I add case studies?
Yes, if they are factual and any necessary permission is obtained.

website-templates-vs-custom.answer: A template is a useful starting point when your business needs a familiar website structure within a defined scope. Custom development is better suited to distinctive workflows or requirements that do not fit a template. Kubhexa offers six interactive templates and custom app development; compare the actual needs before requesting a quote.
faqs: Can templates be customised?
Kubhexa offers customisable website templates; agree the specific changes in your quote.
Are the demo businesses real?
No, the previews represent fictional sample experiences.
When is custom development useful?
When requirements involve unique functions, workflows or integrations.
Can I try a template first?
Yes, the gallery contains six interactive template previews.
